card: SS-2026-11-W1-05 · reel_motion (code-rendered motion graphics, voiced), tier O30 (20 to 35 s) · job convert · belief B5 ('a system beats buying pieces'; vault line: 'You don't need more marketing. You need marketing that works together.') · awareness solution_aware · cta_type keyword: comment ANALIZA (the live keyword) · hook_type comparison · narrow product: the same boosted post followed twice, once with nothing after the click, once with a path after the click (a reply, a second message, a booking step); the boost is a piece, the path makes it work. Must NOT imply that boosting doesn't work. AI label on (AI voice).
facts:
- The owner's own words: 'paratë e reklamave zhduken' (the ad money disappears). He has tried boosting posts and more ads.
- B1: 'Your ads aren't failing. Your enquiries are dying after the click.'
- The free analysis: free, 45 minutes, at our office in Tirana or at the client's business, no obligation. Next step: comment ANALIZA; a DM sends the booking step.
- Nothing about what the analysis covers, finds or shows.
- No euro amounts, no results, no counts.
hook:
Visual from frame 1: a click pointer taps an unbranded mock post card (a drawn shopfront picture, a small megaphone icon meaning 'promoted', no platform label, no logo, no numbers). The view jumps to a messages screen headed 'Mesazhet' (Messages): completely empty, a comic tumbleweed rolling across. The two-lane comparison starts after 3 s.
Text hook (top third, 0-3 s): 'Paratë e reklamave zhduken? / Shiko pas klikimit.' [Ad money disappears? / Look after the click.]
Spoken L1 (fixed): see line 1.
structure: ST10 comparison (the same post, two endings), compact, second-person narrator ('ti' is always the owner, 'ata/i' the people who click). The only variable: what the business set up after the click. Lane 1: nothing invites them to write, so they look and leave (this is why 'asnjë mesazh' in the hook). Lane 2: they are invited into a chat, and the owner replies, writes again and sets a meeting. One picture: a path after the click (grey = stops, red = runs on). O30 rungs: recognition (L1), the variable (L2), the cause in one plain line (L3), the fix (L4), the payoff naming the missing piece in the hook's words (L5), CTA keyword (L6).
end_card: Ivory card: small 'Paratë e reklamave zhduken?' above a large 'Komento ANALIZA'; below: 'Analizë falas · 45 minuta · në zyrën tonë në Tiranë ose te biznesi yt · pa detyrim'; small line 'Hapi për takimin vjen në mesazh' [The step to book the meeting comes in a message]; StraightScale wordmark. Held to 32.0 s.

lines.sq: Paguan sponsorizimin, njerëzit klikojnë, dhe pastaj asnjë mesazh. Ku shkuan?
lines.en: You pay for the boost, people click, and then not one message. Where did they go?
lines.super: 0-3 s text hook 'Paratë e reklamave zhduken? / Shiko pas klikimit.'
lines.visual: Pointer taps the unbranded promoted post card; jump to the empty 'Mesazhet' screen; a comic tumbleweed rolls across and off.

lines.sq: I njëjti postim, dy herë. Ndryshon vetëm ajo pas klikimit.
lines.en: The same post, twice. Only what comes after the click changes.
lines.super: 'I njëjti postim, dy herë' [The same post, twice]
lines.visual: The post card splits into two identical cards, side by side, two lanes; the same pointer clicks each.

lines.sq: Herën e parë, askush s'i fton të shkruajnë. Shohin dhe ikin.
lines.en: The first time, nobody invites them to write. They look and leave.
lines.super: '1: askush s'i fton të shkruajnë' [1: nobody invites them to write]
lines.visual: Left lane: the click opens only the post, with no 'Shkruaj' (Write) button; a dotted path drawn in grey runs a little and ends in empty space. Small figures look and walk off the edge; the tumbleweed passes.

lines.sq: Herën e dytë, i fton në bisedë. Ti përgjigjesh, i shkruan sërish, i cakton takim.
lines.en: The second time, you invite them into a chat. You reply, you write to them again, you set them a meeting.
lines.super: '2: i fton · përgjigjesh · shkruan sërish · takim' [2: invite · reply · write again · meeting]
lines.visual: Right lane: the same post has a 'Shkruaj' (Write) button; the click opens a chat; a figure writes (left side); then, on the right side with a small shop icon, in brand red, the path lights three stops: the owner's reply, the owner's second message, a meeting card with a calendar icon (no dates, no numbers).

lines.sq: Sponsorizimi s'ka faj. Mungon rruga pas klikimit.
lines.en: The boost isn't to blame. The path after the click is missing.
lines.super: 'Sponsorizimi s'ka faj' then 'Mungon rruga pas klikimit' [The boost isn't to blame / The path after the click is missing]
lines.visual: The left lane's grey path turns red and draws on through the same stops as the right lane. Both lanes now look the same.

lines.sq: Komento ANALIZA, dhe hapi për takim të vjen në mesazh. Falas, dyzet e pesë minuta, pa detyrim.
lines.en: Comment ANALIZA, and the step to book a meeting comes to you in a message. Free, forty-five minutes, no obligation.
